===Origin===
Glalie appears to be based on human features, like those of a cold, distant person or facial expression. It also appears somewhat similar to an {{wp|goaltender mask|ice hockey mask}}. Due to its Japanese name, horns, and teeth, it may be based on an ''{{wp|oni}}'' or {{wp|Tsurube-otoshi}}. The oni-like features and mask-like appearance may reference the {{wp|Namahage}}, demons portrayed by men wearing oni masks and straw capes (mino) as part of a ritual in northern Japan. Glalie's pre-Evolution Snorunt appears to wear a mino. It may also be based on ''{{wp|onigiri}}'' ([[rice ball]]), as its Japanese name suggests. It also resembles a {{wp|hail}}stone.

Mega Glalie appears to wear a {{wp|beard}}.

====Name origin====
Glalie may be a combination of ''{{wp|glacier}}'' and ''{{wp|Goaltender|goalie}}''.

Onigohri is a combination of 鬼 ''{{wp|oni}}'' (demon), 氷 ''kōri'' (ice), and ''goalie'' — former [[Game Freak]] staff Akihito Tomisawa stated that he coined the name because he thought the Pokémon looked like a goalie mask.<ref>[https://bsky.app/profile/maneaterbooks.bsky.social/post/3ktfj5jndl72y Akihito Tomisawa (@maneaterbooks.bsky.social) on Bluesky]</ref> The name may also be a pun on ''{{wp|onigiri}}''.
